summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter, per the spec. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, indent = 4*level); rich/align.py adds Align width constraint to measured maximum (min with explicit width), Align.__repr__, and VerticalCenter with render, measure, and repr; rich/console.py sets justify="default" in render options; tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gain the imports and new tests; CHANGELOG.md 9.8.0 marked Unreleased with an Added subheading. Nothing was committed. Tests were not run because the instructions forbade running repository code, so all changes are verified by reading only. Open risk: Align with an empty renderable constrains to width 0, which the spec requires but I did not check the output for.
